name: Strawberry-Kiwi Topped Dessert Cake Shells with Mascarpone Whipped Cream

instructions.primary_message: Place a large bowl (preferably metal) in the freezer to chill. (If space is limited, place in the refrigerator.)
Wash, dry, trim, and thinly slice strawberries. Place on a plate.
Wash, dry, peel, and trim kiwis; quarter lengthwise, then slice crosswise into bite-sized pieces. Add to the plate with the strawberries and set aside.
Remove bowl from the freezer. Place mascarpone in the bowl and, using a hand-held mixer, whisk on medium until smooth, about 1 minute.

Add cream, powdered sugar, vanilla, and salt to the bowl, then continue to beat until medium-soft peaks form, about 3 minutes. (When you pull the beaters out of the bowl, the cream mixture should hold its shape, with a peak that curls over slightly.)
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups heavy whipping cream
3 tbsp powdered sugar
¼ tsp vanilla extract
1 pinch salt

instructions.primary_message: Fill dessert cake shells with whipped cream, then decorate with sliced fruit.
instructions.secondary_message: 2 (5 oz) pkg mini cake dessert shells

instructions.primary_message: To serve, arrange filled dessert cake shells on a platter and enjoy! If planning ahead, cover dessert cups with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve.
